# More reliable connections and rubric capture
- Shared-project downloads finish transmitting before the source closes the connection, reducing interrupted transfers. - Connection diagnostics distinguish completed server work from a download successfully received on the other device. - Rubric status checks recover automatically after brief service contention, keeping the same request and access permissions. Persistent errors remain visible with a recovery action.
## Before repeating a rubric request
Update LeonardoMD and ensure its bundled Leonardo Sync helper is current. If Synchronization preferences report an outdated helper, disable and re-enable Leonardo Sync, then check that it is running. Existing pairing and permissions are preserved. Keep Little Leonardo active while accepting, drawing and sending the requested rubric; review the returned drawing on the Mac before saving or inserting it.
This is a macOS beta. On-demand caching is not included, and no new Little Leonardo build is distributed with this package. Transfers require a reachable, explicitly authorized source.

## Clearer file selection and readable Leonardo filenames
The active file stays highlighted in the project explorer, including MDLF, MDLR and MDLZ, even when automatic following is turned off. Selection uses the system highlight with readable text and icons.
Leonardo filenames retain their wine color in light appearance and use a brighter tint in dark appearance. The English and Spanish guides explain selection and automatic following separately; existing personal guide copies remain intact.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Candidate-specific installed update and relaunch acceptance remains pending.
